description: List ndekoui registry items of one kind. Kinds: primitive (Base UI building blocks such as button or dialog), component (ready compositions such as accordion-01), block (product sections such as heroes-01), template (whole pages), motion (animation components) and lib (theme, utilities, icons, sample images, hooks). Narrow with category: a category or group slug such as accordion, heroes or application, or a component family such as forms or overlays. Paged with offset and limit.

category.description: A category or group slug (accordion, heroes, application) or a component family (forms, overlays)

name: list_items
title: List items
